title: Mnemonic Magic & Acronyms
subtitle: Create hilarious sentences to remember any list in perfect order!

sections.prompt: Can you name all 8 planets in order from the Sun without searching?
sections.subtext: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune...

panels.text: Mia has a big science quiz tomorrow on the Solar System planets in order from the Sun. Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars... and she gets stuck!
Professor Piko grins: 'Take the first letter of each planet: M - V - E - M - J - S - U - N. Now make a funny sentence out of them!'
'My Very Educated Mother Just Served Us Nachos!' M=Mercury, V=Venus, E=Earth, M=Mars, J=Jupiter, S=Saturn, U=Uranus, N=Neptune!
Nachos in space! Every time I think of hungry space astronauts eating nachos, the whole solar system pops into my head!
COSMIC MNEMONIC ENGINE READY! Let's build sentence bridges in the simulation!
